promise.text: Pictures from any image tool, with type that stays correct.

meta.hypothesis: A photographic cover earns more sends than a graphic cover.

caption:
Image tools paint beautifully and spell badly.

Ask for a picture with no words in it, then let the engine set the type. Spelling comes from your plan, and contrast gets measured on the finished slide. Send this to whoever makes your graphics.

#CarouselDesign #AIImages

slides.headline: Never let models spell.
slides.alt: Brass crown on a green velvet cushion above a dark panel with the headline Never let models spell.
slides.visual_prompt: Moody still life of a brass crown on a green velvet cushion, soft window light, calm dark stone in the lower half. No text, no lettering, no logos.

slides.headline: Better prompts won't save you.
slides.myth: A sharper prompt fixes the letters
slides.fact: Keep letters out of the picture
slides.alt: Ivory slide correcting the belief that a sharper prompt fixes letters: keep letters out of the picture.
slides.visual_prompt: Struck-through myth above a lime fact panel.

slides.headline: Split the job in two.
slides.alt: Three numbered steps: the model paints the plate, the engine sets the type, the audit measures the result.

slides.headline: Ask for these.
slides.alt: Checklist for a good plate: no text in the prompt, one calm area for type, your palette in HEX.

slides.headline: Paint first. Type last.
slides.body: Your next set will read correctly on the first try.
slides.alt: Dark closing slide saying paint first and type last, with a lime panel asking to send the post to a designer.
slides.visual_prompt: Dark close with one lime action panel.
